description:
Shortlist products Man of Many recommends, across its published guides and gift guides.

    Use for gift ideas and shopping questions, e.g. "gift for a coffee lover under $200",
    "watch under $1,500". Each pick comes with the guide it is from, our short verdict, the
    price as published and the retailer link exactly as published.

limit.description: Number of picks to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.
limit.title: Limit

max_price_aud.description: Optional budget ceiling per item in Australian dollars, as a number (e.g. 200). When set, picks without a listed price are dropped.
max_price_aud.title: Max Price Aud

query.description: The product, recipient or interest to shortlist for, e.g. "gifts for dads who cook", "watch", "noise cancelling headphones".
query.title: Query

name: product_picks
title: Product picks
